content: wezterm IME on Wayland: relies on XIM protocol (XMODIFIERS=@im=ibus), native text-input-v3 tracked in open issue wezterm#1772; IBus breakage reports #5125, preedit not working #3411, perf degradation from repeated IME reconnect attempts #6925 (fixed in main), and shifted-keys-register-as-unshifted #4615 traced to ibus#2600. alacritty historically has no IME support. Terminals are second-class IME citizens on Wayland - correction insertion needs wl-clipboard fallback or explicit v1 refusal (spec Q3).
